title: Seller Performance Standing Scale on Chargeback Fees Returned by Northloop Payments
content:
The chargeback fee money returned on a won Northloop Payments chargeback case is scaled by the seller's current level in Seller Performance Standing through the standing history multiplier.

**Rule.** The standing history multiplier is 0.5 when the seller's current performance standing level is Below Standard Level or Developing Seller Level, 0.75 when it is Standard Level or Above Standard Level, and 1 at Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level.

| Current Seller Performance Standing level | Standing history multiplier |
|---|---|
| Below Standard Level | 0.5 |
| Developing Seller Level | 0.5 |
| Standard Level | 0.75 |
| Above Standard Level | 0.75 |
| Top Rated Level | 1 |
| Preferred Partner Level | 1 |

The level read is the seller's current level on the Seller Performance Standing record.
